title: First Passage Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.22714v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Augmenting softmax attention with forget gates typically relies on summing decay contributions along the key--query path. Because such accumulation is monotonic, these mechanisms cannot selectively erase intermediate context while preserving older, structurally relevant tokens. We propose First Passage Attention (FPA), which shifts from path summation to path extrema by lowering a key's logit proportionally to the deepest dip of a learned scalar field below that key's level over the intervening span. FPA encompasses the Forgetting Transformer (FoX) as a special case, and when the field and levels follow a shared learned walk, the alive keys with unpenalised logits naturally form a stack. We show that a constant-dimension FPA head realises any subset of keys left alive by subsequent dips, whereas softmax heads with positional biases or token-level forget gates require a head dimension linear in the number of keys. translated_abstract: 使用遗忘门增强softmax注意力通常依赖于沿键-查询路径对衰减贡献进行求和。由于这种累加是单调的，这些机制无法在保留较旧的、结构上相关的token的同时，选择性地擦除中间的上下文。我们提出首次通过注意力，它将从路径求和转向路径极值：通过将某个键的logit按比例降低，降低量与中间跨度上学习到的标量场低于该键水平的最深下凹成正比。FPA将遗忘Transformer（FoX）作为特例包含在内，并且当标量场和水平遵循共享的学习随机游走时，具有未受惩罚logit的存活键自然形成一个栈。我们证明，一个常数维度的FPA头可以实现由后续下凹所留下的任意存活键子集，而带有位置偏置或token级遗忘门的softmax头则需要与键数量呈线性关系的头维度。在合成实验中
tldr: 该论文提出首次通过注意力（FPA），将注意力衰减机制从路径求和转向路径极值——根据学习标量场在中间跨度上的最深下凹来惩罚键的logit，从而能在保留较旧结构相关token的同时选择性擦除中间上下文，并证明常数维度的FPA头即可实现任意存活键子集，而传统softmax头或token级遗忘门需要与键数呈线性关系的维度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes First Passage Attention (FPA), which shifts attention decay from path summation to path extrema by penalizing a key's logit based on the deepest dip of a learned scalar field, enabling selective erasure of intermediate context while preserving older relevant tokens, and proves that a constant-dimension FPA head can realize any subset of alive keys where traditional methods require a dimension linear in the number of keys.
